bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Fx 'deploy-gaybbs-1' >/dev/null
docker exec -i deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs -e '(async()=>{try{const fs=require("node:fs");const p=process.env.BOT_TOKEN_FILE;const t=p?fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8").trim():process.env.BOT_TOKEN;if(!t)process.exit(42);const r=await fetch("https://api.telegram.org/bot"+t+"/getMe");const j=await r.json();if(!j.ok)process.exit(46);if(j.result.username?.toLowerCase()!=="gaybbs_bot")process.exit(47);process.exit(0)}catch(e){const m=String(e?.message||"");process.exit(m.includes("fetch failed")?65:m.includes("ENOENT")?66:m.includes("require is not defined")?67:m.includes("SyntaxError")?68:69)}})()'
